title: Mess Machine moved to your new GitHub
thisBuild: The app now gets its updates, sound packs and note replies from hubbub0/Mess-Machine instead of TideClock.
Nothing else changed: same keys, sounds and layout as the last build.
watch: Does Check for updates still find this build?
Send one test note: does it reach GitHub and come back with a reply?
limits: Your saved notes token was made on TideClock and stops working after the move. In Notes, make a new one while signed in as hubbub0 (the app shows the steps) and paste it in.
